After binding, local rules are copied to the phone; TV rules and password become read-only.
Local settings uploaded. They are now read-only on the TV.

With remote management on, this TV uploads its parent-center settings (including the parent password verifier), time progress and quiz records to the PlanYourTV cloud for remote management and record viewing on your phone, not for advertising or other purposes. The AI model key (API Key) stored on this TV is never uploaded. You can unbind on the phone at any time; uploading stops and the TV keeps its local settings. By continuing, you confirm that you are authorized to manage this TV.
Turn on child mode and auto update?

Turning on child mode also turns on Auto Update, so this TV gets new versions and fixes promptly. New versions download and install automatically while the TV is idle, without interrupting viewing. You can turn Auto Update off at any time in Parent Center.
